meta.title: A maze is carved, then braided until it has no dead ends

views.label: The carve
views.note: A depth-first walk between junctions, opening two cells of corridor per step.

views.label: The braid
views.note: A sweep that opens a second exit beside every junction that has only one.

views.label: Where things start
views.note: The player and the ghost are placed by asking the finished maze, not by fixed coordinates.

choice() -> an unvisited junction two cells away
opens the dividing wall and the junction beyond
messages.note: Two cells of corridor per step. With nothing new two cells away the walk backs up, and every retreat leaves a dead end.

messages.label: a perfect maze: one route between any two cells
choice() -> which closed wall beside a dead end
opens it, giving two junctions an extra exit at once
messages.note: Nothing ever loses an exit, so a junction once fixed stays fixed and the sweep only repeats until a pass changes nothing.

messages.label: no junction left with a single way out
a maze with loops, islands and no dead ends

cards.title: Two passes, opposite jobs
items: The carve leaves a perfect maze: one route everywhere, so dead ends everywhere.
Braiding opens a second exit beside each, trading perfectness for loops.

cards.title: What is guaranteed
items: Every corridor cell reaches every other, so no pill is stranded.
No corridor stops, so the simplest ghost never has to turn round.

cards.title: Repeatable, and checkable
items: A seed repeats a maze; _dead_ends and _islands report what came out.
One thread, before the game loop and before curses draws anything.
